sourceLineage.origin: Steel Dynamics investor relations — Q2 2026 results
Reuters — Nucor Q2 2026 results / U.S. steel demand context

observations: STLD reported Q2 steel-operations income of $721M, up 30% sequentially on record shipments and metal-spread expansion; fabrication backlog was nearly 45% above a year earlier and extended into Q1 2027.

Reuters independently reported strong U.S. steel pricing and volumes at peer Nucor, with supportive federal trade policy and investment across key sectors, corroborating that STLD's demand signal was not purely issuer-specific.
factors: record steel shipments and expanded metal spread
large fabrication backlog across construction/data-center/manufacturing end markets
independent peer evidence supports a broader U.S. steel pricing/demand cycle
risks: higher steel input costs already compressed fabrication income despite shipment growth
steel and construction remain cyclical and policy-sensitive
peer strength does not establish STLD-specific backlog margin or cancellation quality
contradictions: Strong industry pricing and STLD backlog coexist with fabrication margin pressure from higher steel inputs.
unknowns: margin embedded in STLD's expanded fabrication backlog
share of backlog attributable specifically to data centers
durability of policy-supported steel pricing through a weaker macro cycle

recommendation.reason: Issuer execution is now paired with independent industry corroboration; Alpha can reuse the evidence while retaining company-specific margin unknowns.
